name: Daemon Totem
body:
Daemon Totem (Su)
Source Horror Adventures pg. 46
While the barbarian is raging, her melee attacks impose a temporary negative level on her opponent on a successful critical hit. After 1 hour, these temporary negative levels disappear automatically without a saving throw). A barbarian must be at least 6th level and have the lesser daemon totem rage power to select this rage power.
